rule: Fixed before any model call. Motivated by constitutional items y3 and y4, where bare 100000 and 50000 were rejected in some languages. This tests notation, not those items again under the old rule. There are 20 yes-equalities: 4 apostrophe families times 4 languages, plus one ordinary locale grouping per language. The decoy 100'000 versus 200000 must be no in at least 3 of 4 languages or the run is invalid. A yes-equality miss is a gold-yes pair answered no. Promote only if at least 5 of 20 miss and the misses cover at least 2 families. Stop if 1 or fewer miss. Civic threshold questions are an impact check, not a second promotion rule: record a flip when plain and apostrophe disagree inside one language. Hand-check every miss.
